svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.8.8.1 Required Guards
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.8 STAIRS, RAMPS, LANDINGS, HANDRAILS AND GUARDS
Required Guards

g.text: More than 600 mm above the surface
within 1.2 m: guard on each open side
A raised planter does not avoid the guard.
The ground within 1.2 m is still more
600 mm or less above the ground:
DOORS AND OPENABLE WINDOWS IN RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS (NOT TO SCALE)
Openable window: a guard, or a device
Not needed where the bottom of the
openable part is more than 900 mm
above the floor, or less than 1 800 mm
above the floor or ground outside.
A guard, or a mechanism that

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Every surface to which access is provided has a guard on each side
not protected by a wall, where the difference in elevation is more
than 600 mm (23⅝″) to the adjacent surface within 1.2 m (3′-11¼″)
Includes flights of steps and ramps, exterior landings, porches,
balconies, mezzanines, galleries and raised walkways. Except as in
Sentence (2) and at the leading edge at the top of a flight.
Not required at loading docks, at floor pits in repair garages, or
where access is for maintenance purposes only
Residential doors with the floor on one side more than 600 mm above
the other side: a guard, or a mechanism limiting any clear opening
to not more than 100 mm (3 15/16″)
Openable residential windows: a guard, or a mechanism released only
with tools or special knowledge that limits the opening to not more
than 100 mm, vertically or horizontally
Except as provided in Sentence (5).
Not needed where the bottom edge of the openable portion is more
than 900 mm (35 7/16″) above the finished floor, or less than 1 800
mm (5′-10⅞″) above the floor or ground on the other side
Glazing over stairs, ramps and landings extending to less than 1
070 mm (3′-6⅛″) above them: protected by guards, or non-openable
and designed for balcony guard lateral loads (Article 4.1.5.14.)
Except as provided in Sentence (7).
In dwelling units and houses with a secondary suite: the same, for
such glazing extending to less than 900 mm
Glazing in public areas above the second storey of residential
buildings, extending to less than 1 m (3′-3⅜″) from the floor: the
same
Drawn: an exterior deck and stair at one house. Guard heights are illustration only (see Article 9.8.8.3.).
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.8.8.1. (page 9-37), with Notes A-9.8.8.1. and A-9.8.8.1.(4).
